Information on seating plans for pet owners
What you should know comes first

Seating Plans for Pet Owners

Traveling with a pet is easier when the seating plan is clear from the start. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways helps match your booking with the right cabin setup, so you can keep your focus on the trip and on your animal's comfort.

<<FACT F091>> The team reviews each request with care and checks that the seat choice works with the rest of the booking. If your plans change, let the desk know as soon as you can so the crew can update the notes that guide boarding and care.

<<FACT F085>> Bring any details the desk asks for, since they help the staff prepare the cabin space and share the right instructions with the team. Travelers like Tomas Wong and Arjun Dubois have found that a clear record makes the process smoother, especially when an animal needs extra space or calm handling.

If you are traveling with a pet carrier, keep it ready for inspection and follow the boarding guidance given by the desk. The crew uses those notes to support a safe and steady experience from check-in to pickup, and that shared attention helps everyone onboard.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways and the team will walk you through the next steps.
